message: border-radius isn't supported in Outlook Windows; partly in Yahoo! Mail Desktop Webmail, Yahoo! Mail iOS, Yahoo! Mail Android
hint: Round corners can be used in VML with the `RoundRect` element. See the [VML documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/vml/msdn-online-vml-roundrect-element).
A negative margin only works as a full-bleed band: it must exactly cancel the parent's padding, and a top or bottom bleed must be the parent's first or last child with its own padding on that edge.
